name: Community Water Development Fund

funder.name: Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage (Ireland)

summary: Annual grants for Irish community and voluntary groups and environmental NGOs to improve water quality through river and wetland restoration, nature-based solutions and habitat works. The 2026 round closed in January 2026.

amount.note: Higher grant rates may be considered in certain circumstances

status.quote: Closing Date Deadlines Applications via Online Portal www.lawaters.ie 11 Wednesday, 20 January 2026 at th 11:30pm

deadline.quote: Closing Date Deadlines Applications via Online Portal www.lawaters.ie 11 Wednesday, 20 January 2026 at th 11:30pm

applicant_types.quote: Organisations based in the Republic of Ireland only Not-for-profit Community and Voluntary Groups Rural and Urban Networks Environmental Non-Government Organisations

geography.quote: The Fund is open to eligible applicants in the Republic of Ireland only.

window.quote: Closing Date Deadlines Applications via Online Portal www.lawaters.ie 11 Wednesday, 20 January 2026 at th 11:30pm

amount.quote: the minimum individual grant amount awarded under this scheme will be €5,000 up to a maximum of €40,000

administered_by.quote: provided by the Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage and administered by River Basin Management Service

co_finance_required.quote: It is not a grant condition, but it is recommended that applicants can demonstrate their ability to make a cash contribution
